Private Function Shown(v As Variant) As String
    If IsObject(v) Then
        Shown = "object"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Or IsNull(v) Then
        Shown = TypeName(v)
    Else
        Shown = CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
